description: The user's Replo workspaces. Call right after sign-in: use the only workspace, or ask the user once which to use when there are several, then pass its id as workspaceId on Sightglass calls. Also use it when the user wants to switch workspaces. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").
name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
